instruction: A candid medium-shot photograph of a minimalist indoor room with white walls and light wooden flooring. On the left, the man in the brown sweater (R1) sits in a light wooden armchair, holding a notebook on his lap and extending a glass of water with his right hand. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt (R2) sits on a teal velvet chair, leaning forward and reaching out with his left hand to take the glass. The room is brightly lit with soft, even light and gentle shadows.
